case.note: The subluxating-nerve configuration (recurrent luxation in 16.2% of the general population, T32). The release is identical to the clean attempt; at the dynamic stability assessment (m6.1) the nerve is unstable, and the configuration decision (dp5) routes to anterior transposition - the consulted protocol's rule (T31) and the specialty's one consensus (T29). The decision makes the transposition microsteps required and drops the in-situ completion: the nerve is mobilised with its perineural vessels preserved, the medial intermuscular septum is released, the nerve is transposed anterior to the medial epicondyle without tension, and its gliding is re-confirmed through the full range. 33 required microsteps, all performed.

trace.name: Ulnar nerve decompression: subluxating nerve - anterior transposition configuration
